title: Agentic workflow fails in pre-agent setup before the engine starts
symptoms: Agentic workflow reports an engine crash or incomplete result although the agent never started
Install GitHub Copilot CLI step fails after repeated HTTP 504 responses while downloading the checksum manifest
Smoke workflow exhausts its execution timeout during a cold local Docker image build
AWF invocation combines a compiler-pinned image manifest with --build-local
Maintenance workflow npm ci fails certificate verification against a blocked package mirror
conditions: The failure occurs in a setup step (installer download, local image build, dependency install, awf image selection) before the timed engine execution; the agent exit code is absent rather than nonzero
Cold local image builds share the engine execution budget when image preparation is not a separate step
Maintenance workflows listed in publishedAwfWorkflowLockFiles must keep the compiler-selected AWF binary and digest-pinned images; local validation workflows keep --build-local
Only curl download failures of the Copilot installer are retried; checksum, version and installation errors fail immediately
A job-level timeout, an installer 504 and a blocked package host are different causes that share the symptom of no agent output
rootCause: Setup work was coupled to the timed agent execution or to an incompatible AWF image mode. Smoke workflows now prepare run-tagged local images in a separate 35-minute step and select them with --image-registry awf-smoke --image-tag "${AWF_SMOKE_IMAGE_TAG:?}" --skip-pull; maintenance workflows in the published-release list preserve the compiler-pinned binary and images instead of --build-local; the Copilot installer is retried up to three times on curl download failures only; and the Test Quality Improver prepares root dependencies from the public registry before sandbox startup.

probe.expect: Classify the failing step first: installer download, local image preparation, dependency install, or awf image selection. A published-release maintenance workflow should show install_awf_binary and no --build-local; a prepared-image smoke workflow should show a separate Build local AWF smoke images step before execution. Match the failing run's step name from existing run metadata; absent evidence of the failing step is unknown.

action: Use source whose lock was regenerated and post-processed so the affected workflow is in the correct group (published release, prepared smoke images, or retried installer). Fix the classified setup step; do not widen the network allowlist, loosen checksum or version pins, add --build-local to a published-release workflow, or raise the execution timeout to absorb image builds. Hosted acceptance remains separate.
